signal_constraints.name: engine_entry_zone
signal_constraints.definition: CHECK ((((engine_version IS NULL) AND (entry_low IS NULL) AND (entry_high IS NULL)) OR ((engine_version = 'vestrado-structure-v1'::text) AND (source = 'mt5'::text) AND (entry_low > (0)::numeric) AND (entry_high >= entry_low) AND ((entry >= entry_low) AND (entry <= entry_high)) AND ((entry_high - entry_low) <= (8)::numeric)) OR ((engine_version = 'tick-volume-momentum-v1'::text) AND (source = 'mt5'::text) AND (entry_low = entry) AND (entry_high = entry) AND (access = 'public'::text))))

signal_constraints.name: signals_check
signal_constraints.definition: CHECK ((((direction = 'BUY'::text) AND (stop_loss < entry) AND (entry < tp1) AND (tp1 < tp2) AND (tp2 < tp3)) OR ((direction = 'SELL'::text) AND (stop_loss > entry) AND (entry > tp1) AND (tp1 > tp2) AND (tp2 > tp3))))

signal_constraints.name: signals_check1
signal_constraints.definition: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['active'::signal_status, 'closed'::signal_status])) OR ((approved_by IS NOT NULL) AND (published_at IS NOT NULL)) OR ((status = 'closed'::signal_status) AND (published_at IS NULL))))

signal_constraints.name: signals_reasoning_check
signal_constraints.definition: CHECK (((length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reasoning)) >= 20) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM reasoning)) <= 2000)))

signal_constraints.name: tick_method_frame
signal_constraints.definition: CHECK (((((strategy IS DISTINCT FROM 'TICK_VOLUME'::text) AND (timeframe IS DISTINCT FROM 'M5'::text)) OR ((strategy = 'TICK_VOLUME'::text) AND (timeframe = 'M5'::text) AND (higher_timeframe IS NULL) AND (engine_version = 'tick-volume-momentum-v1'::text))) IS TRUE))

signal_constraints.name: valid_signal_method
signal_constraints.definition: CHECK ((((strategy IS NULL) AND (timeframe IS NULL) AND (higher_timeframe IS NULL)) OR ((strategy IS NOT NULL) AND (timeframe IS NOT NULL) AND ((higher_timeframe IS NULL) OR (timeframe_minutes(higher_timeframe) > timeframe_minutes(timeframe))))))
